description: Diagnostic pattern library for Kubernetes Agent. Includes Graph (Topology), Jaeger (Trace), and Prometheus (Metric) integration.

patterns.name: 503/5xx Service Errors
patterns.description: Triage pattern for 5xx HTTP errors. Discriminates between connectivity issues, routing problems, and cascading failures.

discriminating_queries.name: check_service_endpoints
discriminating_queries.query: MATCH (s:Service {name: $service_name})-[:IN_NAMESPACE]->(ns:Namespace {name: $namespace}) OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:SELECTS_PODS]->(p:Pod) RETURN s.name, count(p) as endpoint_count

discriminating_queries.name: check_downstream_failures
discriminating_queries.query: MATCH (s:Service {name: $service_name})-[c:FAILED_CALL_TO]->(downstream:Service) WHERE c.status_code =~ '5..' RETURN downstream.name, c.status_code, c.last_observed ORDER BY c.last_observed DESC LIMIT 5

discriminating_queries.name: check_istio_routing
discriminating_queries.query: MATCH (vs:VirtualService)-[:ROUTES_TRAFFIC_FOR]->(s:Service {name: $service_name}) OPTIONAL MATCH (dr:DestinationRule)-[:DEFINES_POLICY_FOR]->(s) RETURN vs.name, vs.http_routes, dr.subsets

initial_investigation_steps: Check if the failing service has endpoints (SELECTS_PODS edges)
Check for FAILED_CALL_TO relationships to downstream services
Determine if the error is coming from the Ingress/LoadBalancer or the Pod itself
For Istio environments: Check VirtualService and DestinationRule configuration

patterns.name: High Latency
patterns.description: Triage pattern for latency. Uses Tracing and Metrics to distinguish between Network, Downstream, or Local CPU issues.

discriminating_queries.name: check_trace_network_lag
discriminating_queries.query: MATCH (s:Span)-[:CHILD_OF]->(parent:Span) WHERE s.service_name = $service_name AND (s.start_time - parent.start_time) > 100 RETURN s.trace_id, (s.start_time - parent.start_time) as network_lag

discriminating_queries.name: check_downstream_latency
discriminating_queries.query: MATCH (s:Service {name: $service_name})-[c:CALLS]->(downstream:Service) RETURN downstream.name, c.avg_latency_ms, c.p99_latency_ms ORDER BY c.p99_latency_ms DESC

discriminating_queries.name: check_cpu_throttling
discriminating_queries.query: MATCH (s:Service {name: $service_name})-[:SELECTS_PODS]->(p:Pod) WHERE p.cpu_throttled_seconds > 5 RETURN p.name, p.cpu_throttled_seconds

discriminating_queries.name: check_hpa_saturation
discriminating_queries.query: MATCH (h:HPA)-[:SCALES]->(d:Deployment)-[:MANAGES]->(rs:ReplicaSet)-[:MANAGES]->(p:Pod) WHERE p.name CONTAINS $service_name RETURN h.current_replicas, h.max_replicas

initial_investigation_steps: Query Jaeger: Compare Client Span Duration vs Server Span Duration (Network Gap)
Query Prometheus: Check CPU Throttling metrics for the pods
Check CALLS relationships for slow downstream dependencies
Check HPA status for saturation

patterns.name: Pod Crashes and Restarts
patterns.description: Triage pattern for pod failures. Discriminates between resource exhaustion, configuration errors, and storage/image issues.

discriminating_queries.name: check_oom
discriminating_queries.query: MATCH (p:Pod {name: $pod_name}) RETURN p.status, p.restart_reason, p.memory_limit, p.memory_usage

discriminating_queries.name: check_configmap_usage
discriminating_queries.query: MATCH (p:Pod)-[:USES_CONFIG]->(cm:ConfigMap) WHERE p.name = $pod_name RETURN cm.name, cm.updated_at

initial_investigation_steps: Check Pod events for OOMKilled or MountFailed
If ContainerCreating > 5min, check for Volume Attachment issues
If CrashLoopBackOff, check logs and recent ConfigMap changes

patterns.name: 404 Not Found Errors
patterns.description: Triage pattern for 404 errors. Discriminates between missing routes, incorrect path matching, and missing services.
initial_investigation_steps: Check if this is an internal (Service-to-Service) or external (Ingress-to-Service) request
Verify if HTTPRoute or Ingress exists for the requested path
Verify the target Service exists

patterns.name: 429 Rate Limited
patterns.description: Triage pattern for rate limiting. Discriminates between single-caller overload and shared dependency bottleneck.

discriminating_queries.name: check_callers_to_target
discriminating_queries.query: MATCH (caller:Service)-[c:FAILED_CALL_TO]->(target:Service {name: $service_name}) WHERE c.status_code = '429' RETURN caller.name, c.last_observed, c.error_count ORDER BY c.last_observed DESC

initial_investigation_steps: Identify which service is returning 429s
Count how many different callers are seeing 429s from the same target
If multiple callers to same target: shared bottleneck (fan-in pattern)

patterns.name: 401/403 Authentication Errors
patterns.description: Triage pattern for auth failures. Discriminates between credential issues and permission problems.

discriminating_queries.name: check_shared_secrets
discriminating_queries.query: MATCH (p:Pod)-[:USES_SECRET]->(s:Secret) WHERE p.name CONTAINS $service_name RETURN s.name, s.namespace, s.updated_at, collect(p.name) as affected_pods

initial_investigation_steps: Check if multiple services are failing auth simultaneously
Check Secret updated_at timestamps for recent changes

patterns.name: Multi-Service Simultaneous Failures
patterns.description: Discriminates between shared infrastructure (Nodes) or shared config.

discriminating_queries.name: check_shared_node
discriminating_queries.query: MATCH (p:Pod)-[:SCHEDULED_ON]->(n:Node) WHERE p.name IN $pod_names WITH n, collect(p.name) as pods, count(p) as pod_count WHERE pod_count > 1 RETURN n.name, pods, pod_count, n.status ORDER BY pod_count DESC

discriminating_queries.name: check_node_events
discriminating_queries.query: MATCH (e:K8sEvent)-[:INVOLVES]->(n:Node) WHERE e.reason IN ['NodeNotReady', 'Draining', 'DiskPressure', 'MemoryPressure'] RETURN n.name, e.reason

initial_investigation_steps: Check if failing pods share a common Node
Check K8sEvents for Node-level issues

patterns.name: Service Selector Mismatch
patterns.description: Service exists and Pods exist, but Selector labels or Ports do not match.
investigation_steps: Query Service selector: MATCH (s:Service {name: $service_name}) RETURN s.selector
Query pods in namespace: MATCH (p:Pod)-[:IN_NAMESPACE]->(ns:Namespace) WHERE p.name CONTAINS $service_name RETURN p.labels
Compare Service.selector with Pod.labels
Verify Port Mapping: MATCH (s:Service {name: $service_name}), (p:Pod) RETURN s.target_ports, p.container_ports
Check if SELECTS_PODS edge count is 0
patterns.diagnosis_guidance: If labels match, check the Ports. A common error is Service TargetPort pointing to 80 while Container listens on 8080. If both match, check if pods are in 'NotReady' state.
recommendations: Fix Service selector to match Pod labels
Verify endpoints appear: kubectl get endpoints $service_name

patterns.name: Ingress Misconfiguration
patterns.description: Traffic reaches the Ingress Controller but fails to route to the Service/Pod.
investigation_steps: Check Ingress Backend definition: MATCH (i:Ingress {name: $ingress_name})-[:ROUTES_TO]->(s:Service) RETURN i.rules, s.name
Verify TLS Secret existence and validity
Check Ingress Controller logs for the specific request ID
Validate Ingress annotations (rewrite-target, ssl-redirect)
patterns.diagnosis_guidance: If you see a 'Default Backend' 404, Ingress works but your Host/Path rule didn't match. If 502, Ingress found the Service IP but connection was refused (Pod dead or port wrong).
recommendations: (Platform) Check Ingress Controller logs for reload errors
(Dev) Verify Ingress 'host' matches the URL being requested
(Dev) Check if the Service port matches the Ingress backend port

patterns.name: Cascading Failure
patterns.description: A leaf service failure propagates upstream. The alerted service is a symptom.
investigation_steps: Start at alerted service, query downstream: MATCH (s:Service {name: $service_name})-[c:CALLS]->(downstream:Service) WHERE c.error_rate > 0.1 RETURN downstream.name
Follow the chain recursively until finding a service with NO failing downstream calls
The leaf service is the root cause
patterns.diagnosis_guidance: Errors cascade UPSTREAM. Follow calls DOWNSTREAM. The failing service with healthy dependencies is the culprit.
recommendations: Fix the root cause in the leaf service

patterns.name: Pod Resource Exhaustion
patterns.description: Pod killed (OOM) or throttled (CPU) due to limits.
investigation_steps: Check Pod events for OOMKilled
Query Prometheus: Rate of CPU Throttling > 1s per minute
Compare actual usage vs requests/limits
patterns.diagnosis_guidance: OOMKilled = Memory Limit. Throttling = CPU Limit. If throttling matches latency spikes, CPU is the bottleneck.

patterns.name: HPA Flapping / Saturation
patterns.description: Service oscillates between scaling up/down or hits max replicas.
investigation_steps: Check HPA status: MATCH (h:HPA)-[:SCALES]->(d:Deployment {name: $deployment_name}) RETURN h.current_replicas, h.max_replicas
Check for 'ScalingLimited' events
Correlate latency spikes with HPA scale-up events (cold start)
patterns.diagnosis_guidance: If CurrentReplicas == MaxReplicas, service is under-provisioned (Cap Exceeded). If Replicas oscillate rapidly, it is 'Flapping'.

patterns.name: Volume Attachment Stuck
patterns.description: Pod cannot start because volume is attached to a dead node.
investigation_steps: Check VolumeAttachments: MATCH (va:VolumeAttachment) WHERE va.status != 'Attached' RETURN va.name, va.node
Find the Node the volume is attached to vs where Pod is scheduled
Check for 'Multi-Attach' errors in events
patterns.diagnosis_guidance: Common when a Node crashes. The Cloud Provider thinks volume is still attached to the dead node.
recommendations: (Platform) Force delete the dead pod: kubectl delete pod $pod --grace-period=0 --force
(Platform) Manually detach volume via Cloud Console

patterns.name: Deployment Rollout Stuck
patterns.description: New ReplicaSet pods cannot start or become Ready.
investigation_steps: Compare old vs new ReplicaSet pod status
Check for ImagePullBackOff (Registry/Tag issue)
Check for Readiness Probe failures (App logic issue)
Verify Resource Quota usage in namespace
patterns.diagnosis_guidance: If Pod is 'Running' but not 'Ready', the app is failing the Readiness Probe. If 'ImagePullBackOff', the image is unreachable.
recommendations: Check application logs for startup crashes

patterns.name: Configuration Error
patterns.description: Pod fails to start due to missing ConfigMap/Secret or invalid mounts.
investigation_steps: Verify ConfigMap/Secret existence: MATCH (p:Pod)-[:USES_CONFIG]->(ref) RETURN ref.name
Check volume mount paths
Review app startup logs
patterns.diagnosis_guidance: CrashLoopBackOff on startup usually indicates config/env var issues.

patterns.name: HTTPRoute Misconfiguration
patterns.description: Gateway API HTTPRoute missing or mismatch.
investigation_steps: Check if HTTPRoute exists
Verify path matching rules (Prefix vs Exact)
Verify backend Service reference
patterns.diagnosis_guidance: 404 means Gateway can't find a path to backend.

patterns.name: VirtualService Subset Mismatch
patterns.description: Istio routing to a subset with no pods.
investigation_steps: Get VirtualService destination subset
Match with DestinationRule labels
Count pods with those labels
recommendations: Align DestinationRule labels with Pod labels

patterns.name: Node Resource Contention
patterns.description: Noisy neighbor consuming node resources.
investigation_steps: Identify common node for failing pods
Find pod with highest resource usage on that node
patterns.diagnosis_guidance: One pod with high usage causing others to starve.

patterns.name: ConfigMap Propagation
patterns.description: Bad config pushed to running pods.
investigation_steps: Correlate ConfigMap update time with Pod crash time
patterns.diagnosis_guidance: Crash within 5 mins of ConfigMap update is suspicious.

patterns.name: Diamond Dependency Bottleneck
patterns.description: Shared dependency overloaded by multiple callers.
investigation_steps: Aggregate failures by TARGET service
patterns.diagnosis_guidance: If multiple unrelated services fail calling the SAME target, target is bottleneck.

patterns.name: Shared PVC Exhaustion
patterns.description: Shared ReadWriteMany volume is full.
investigation_steps: Find shared PVC
Identify pod writing most data
patterns.diagnosis_guidance: Disk errors across multiple pods sharing PVC.

patterns.name: Secret Rotation Cascade
patterns.description: Bad credentials rotated into Secret.
investigation_steps: Correlate Secret update time with Auth failure start

patterns.name: Node Drain Impact
patterns.description: Node issues causing mass eviction.
investigation_steps: Check Node events (Draining, DiskPressure)

patterns.name: NetworkPolicy Block
patterns.description: NetworkPolicy blocking cross-namespace traffic.
investigation_steps: Check Trace for missing Server spans (request sent but not received)
Check NetworkPolicies in target namespace
patterns.diagnosis_guidance: Timeout (dropped packet) implies Firewall/Policy. Refused implies App/Port issue.
